provenance: Inventory and hashes were read from pinned Git tree/blob objects before any CodeThread prediction on the three external repositories.

scope.included: Regular committed .ts blobs from the exact pinned commit.
scope.sourceAccess: Read tree and blob objects from Git at the pinned commit; no analyzed-repository scripts or dependencies are executed.

externalRepositories.name: Hono
externalRepositories.architecture: Multi-runtime Web Standards HTTP framework and router with adapter/runtime subprojects.
externalRepositories.selectionReason: Exercises a broad root source tree, adapters, and runtime-specific TypeScript project configs.

externalRepositories.name: Zod
externalRepositories.architecture: TypeScript schema validation and inference monorepo with v3, v4, mini, integration, and tooling packages.
externalRepositories.selectionReason: Exercises package boundaries and multiple TypeScript configurations alongside recursive schema conversion.

externalRepositories.name: Pinia
externalRepositories.architecture: Vue state-management library with Pinia, Nuxt, playground, docs, and testing packages.
externalRepositories.selectionReason: Exercises a package monorepo, nested function owners, recursive state helpers, and cross-file helpers.

supplementaryMonorepo.name: CodeThread
supplementaryMonorepo.architecture: CodeThread's own package monorepo with project references and the repository-analysis CLI.
supplementaryMonorepo.selectionReason: Supplementary self-repository integration case for project contexts and CLI-to-browser navigation; excluded from the external semantic score.
